title: SSC Delhi Police HC AWO TPO PE & MT Date 2026
postName: Head Constable (AWO/TPO) in Delhi Police Examination 2025 – PE&MT
vacancyDetails: 443 revised vacancies for Head Constable (AWO/TPO) in Delhi Police Examination 2025: 297 Male and 146 Female.
qualification: 10+2 (Senior Secondary) pass with Science and Mathematics and other technical qualifications as prescribed in the official SSC notification.
ageLimit: 18 to 27 years as on 01 July 2025, with applicable category-wise age relaxations.
applicationFee: ₹100; women candidates and candidates belonging to SC, ST and eligible Ex-Servicemen categories are exempted as per SSC rules.
selectionProcess: Computer Based Examination → PE&MT → Trade Test / Proficiency Test → Document Verification → Medical Examination → Final Selection
documentsRequired: PE&MT admission certificate, valid original photo ID and other documents specified by Delhi Police/SSC.
howToApply:
1. Visit https://delhipolice.gov.in/recruitments
2. Open the latest PE&MT notice for Head Constable (AWO/TPO) in Delhi Police Examination 2025
3. Check the revised schedule and allotted date
4. Download the PE&MT admission certificate when available
5. Verify the venue and reporting time
6. Appear with the required original documents
shortDescription: SSC Delhi Police Head Constable AWO/TPO PE&MT revised schedule 2026 has been issued. Check the latest schedule on the Delhi Police recruitment portal.
content:
Staff Selection Commission (SSC) conducted the Computer Based Examination for Head Constable (AWO/TPO) in Delhi Police Examination 2025. The CBE result was declared on 29 May 2026, after which shortlisted candidates were required to appear for PE&MT.

Delhi Police issued an important revised PE&MT schedule notice on 03 September 2026 covering HC Ministerial, HC AWO/TPO, Constable Driver and Constable Executive posts. Candidates should follow this latest revised schedule because earlier PE&MT dates were postponed/rescheduled.

The revised vacancy position for HC AWO/TPO is 443 posts, comprising 297 Male and 146 Female vacancies.

Candidates should use the official Delhi Police recruitment portal for the latest PE&MT date, venue and admission certificate.
